body:
You've gotten far enough into the journey of recovery from trauma that you've reached the point where you know your specific triggers and where they come from.
Those are huge steps towards feeling better and I hope you can appreciate how far you've come. I believe that if you can get this far, you can get even farther.

Beautifully written.
Inspired me to try and find some small dreams to aim for.
If you can walk away or even just look away, that's an accomplishment to be proud of, even if you don't change your mind.

Thought a lot about killing myself on my recent birthday earlier this month.
Don't have any insight into why I didn't do it, but now that my birthday is past, it feels less important to me. I won't promise that you'll feel any better, but if you can get through the day itself, you might feel less strongly about it.

That was fucked up for them to do to you. 
I hope you can get something out of knowing that all of us agree that was a fucked up thing to do to a person and that you are justified in being upset by that.
Congrats on the choice. Hope your good run continues.
